text: I did a walk in appointment for a Hollywood Brazilian wax and manicure. The manicure was perfect and the wax was the best I’ve ever had. I went to The Beauty Boutique after having a truly terrible experience at another salon in Chiang Mai, and I can honestly say this time I felt completely reassured.

There were two of us and we came in without an appointment. Unfortunately, we couldn’t get our nails done at the same time, but it didn’t affect the experience at all.

The welcome was excellent: the manager is incredibly kind, friendly, and attentive. She took the time to advise us, suggested beautiful shades, and even recommended several places to visit on the island as a local. We followed her recommendations and it was honestly amazing!

The lady who did my nails was also very professional. She was careful, detail-oriented, and most importantly, she immediately corrected anything when I felt it wasn’t exactly how I wanted it.

In the end, I’m very satisfied with the result. It has now been two weeks and my nails are still perfect.

If I had to mention one small thing, I might have liked one extra coat, but honestly it’s just a tiny detail.

I definitely recommend this place — everything was great!
